name: Origin API Guides · Cursor Skills
description: Consult the Cursor Origin API documentation and plan GitHub App ports. Guides only; no Origin connection is installed.
whenToUse: Explicit requests about Cursor Origin APIs, Origin Apps, scopes, webhooks or planning a GitHub App port to Origin.

items.name: origin-api
items.description: Routes questions about the Cursor Origin API to the right section of the Origin docs and names the few rules to check first. Use when a task mentions Origin, the Origin API, Origin Apps, or Origin webhooks, including creating an Origin App, authenticating as one, calling Origin endpoints, or handling Origin webhook deliveries.

items.name: port-github-app-to-origin
items.description: Plans the port of an existing GitHub App to a Cursor Origin App. Use when the task is to bring a GitHub App to Origin or compare what it uses against the Origin API. Reads the app's needs out of its code, maps them onto the live Origin spec, and writes a porting brief with feedback for Cursor. Planning only.
